name: gods-eye-view
description_en: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
readme_excerpt: 🌐 God's Eye View A spy-satellite simulator in your browser — then you realize the sources are public and the data is real. Photorealistic 3D globe. Live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic, and public cameras, with clearly labeled modeled views where a live feed is unavailable. Hands-free voice control powered by a realtime AI agent. No place left behind. ▶️ From the project behind the viral God's Eye View series (formerly WorldView) — 5M+ on YouTube Quick Start · First Five Minu…
